dream: I lay on the wide anchor, feeling the tall rock press my shoulder like a flat stone. The card hummed a low hum, warm enough to melt the grass beneath me. I woke up floating in a box where the fence leaned too far left, catching my hip with every blink. The air felt thick as wet paper, heavy on the roof I could not see. I pressed down with my own hand, unsure if I was fixing a slide or just marking a spot. Then the wedge bit my heel, and the whole box tipped over into the cool dark.
